records.outcome: the user has seen which organization plugins are already installed and which ones administrators have made available; nothing is installed by these steps
preconditions: administrators have added plugins for the organization
steps: Review installed plugins under Organization plugins
Open the Organization tab to see every plugin administrators made available

evidence.quote: select **Browse plugins** and open the **Organization** tab, which lists every plugin your administrators have made available to you.

records.notes: Claude for Government has no public plugin marketplace; the Organization tab is the catalog.

records.outcome: a plugin from a local .zip file is installed in Claude Desktop, on this device only
steps: Acknowledge the notice to install only plugins you trust

evidence.quote: To install a plugin from a file, select **Add plugin**, then **Upload plugin**, and choose the plugin's `.zip` file.

records.notes: A plugin you upload is added only on the device you are using.

records.outcome: Claude has built a plugin from the user's description and the user has installed the result, on this device only

evidence.quote: select **Add plugin**, then **Create with Claude**, and describe the plugin you want. Claude builds it for you, and you install the result.

records.notes: A plugin you create is added only on the device you are using.

records.outcome: a marketplace of the user's own is registered from Browse plugins so its plugins can be installed, if network controls allow it to be downloaded
preconditions: the deployment's network controls allow the marketplace to be downloaded
steps: Add a plugin marketplace of your own

evidence.quote: You can also add a plugin marketplace of your own from **Browse plugins**.

records.notes: The page names the entry point but not the fields; steps kept to what the text states.

records.outcome: the chosen components of an installed plugin are switched on or off, changing what the plugin contributes
steps: Review the skills, slash commands, sub-agents, and hooks it provides
Turn individual components on or off

evidence.quote: Open an installed plugin to see the skills, slash commands, sub-agents, and hooks it provides, and turn individual components on or off.

records.notes: Connectors declared by a self-added plugin are not added, and a local MCP server it declares never runs.

records.outcome: the plugin is uninstalled and stays removed for the user, including ones administrators set to install automatically
preconditions: the plugin is not one your organization requires

evidence.quote: To remove a plugin, open it and click **Uninstall**.

records.notes: A required plugin cannot be removed; Claude Desktop says it is required by your organization.

coverage_notes: Six procedures extracted from the install, marketplace, and manage sections. The intro, the 'Where plugins come from' list, and 'What plugins add in Claude for Government' are concept text with no actions, apart from the one marketplace sentence.
